agents.note:
*** SPRINT 71 / V0.29.26 IS COMPLETE -- 6/6, all stories passes:true. US-533 landed this iteration (commit 9206878). *** But read the provenance note before treating that as six clean builds.

*** I DID NOT WRITE MOST OF US-533. *** A PRIOR ITERATION implemented it and DIED BEFORE COMMITTING. I found 16 files of uncommitted work in the tree at session start -- exactly the scenario feedback-subagent-died-check-head-first exists for. Checking `git status` before selecting a story is what saved it; had I started implementing from the story card I would have either duplicated or clobbered good work. THE FIRST ACTION OF AN ITERATION SHOULD BE LOOKING AT THE TREE, NOT THE STORY.

MY ACTUAL CODE CONTRIBUTION WAS ONE LINE: deleting an unused `from common.config import overlay` in tests/pi/splash/test_states_http_carousel_per_request.py, the sole ruff error across all 16 files. I verified it was vestigial and not a lost drift guard first -- that file writes its overlay through the REAL POST /settings route, which is a stronger dependency than the import would have been.

WHAT I COULD NOT ATTEST TO, AND WHAT I DID INSTEAD. I never watched the prior iteration's tests fail against absent source, so I have NO RED-first evidence for them and I did not claim any. I substituted MUTATION TESTING, which for this purpose is stronger anyway: RED-first proves a test could fail; mutation proves it fails for the RIGHT REASON. Three mutations, each reverted by hand and the reverts confirmed byte-exact via `git diff --numstat` before committing:
(A) emitter always uses fromConfig -> 2 RED, one of them BEHAVIOURAL (getPowerMode() still 'car' after an overlay write of 'wall'), not just an isinstance check.
(B) carousel back to construction-cached -> 5 RED, headed by test_autoRotateSWrite_isServedWithoutARestart, which IS B1: one running server, POST, re-serve, no bounce.
(C) drop the `ok` conjunct from settingsReloadNeeded -> 2 RED, including a fixture using a TRUTHY-BUT-NOT-TRUE `ok: 'yes'`. The prior iteration correctly carried US-531/532's non-echo discipline into the reload decision -- reloading after a REJECTED write would wipe the error note and repaint the unchanged value, which reads as success. That is the silent no-op the whole band exists to prevent, so it deserved the hardest pin, and it got it.

*** THE HONEST BOUND I FOUND AND WOULD FLAG TO WHOEVER VALIDATES ON THE PI. *** The power-mode chain is proven behaviourally at the EMITTER end but NOT at the main() end: test_card_power_mode_live_wiring pins main() with `assert "configPath=args.config" in source` plus inspect.signature checks, and drives a _FakeOrch rather than a real ApplicationOrchestrator. So 'the deployed Pi builds the LIVE source' rests on a SOURCE-TEXT assertion at the last hop -- the declaration-vs-mechanism family this sprint has now hit five times running. Defensible (main() is hard to drive in-process), but if the power tile reads stale on the Pi, LOOK THERE FIRST.

US-533 AS BUILT, in one line each: B1 -- pi.display.carousel resolved PER REQUEST (the last resolved-at-construction value in _injectHtml), which DELETES the polkit-denied states-http restart instead of authorising it; the band reloads the page itself and says 'applies on reload'. B2 -- audioAlerts removed from the allow-list, and it vanished from the band + injected read + write gate from that ONE deletion, which is the payoff US-530/531/532 were designed for. Power mode genuinely LIVE via OverlayConfigPowerModeSource re-reading each acquire(). Calibration/auto-analyze say 'applies on CAPTURE restart' -- naming the service, because US-532's bare 'restart' was true but pointed at the wrong unit.

US-532's DELIBERATE HANDSHAKE FIRED EXACTLY AS DESIGNED. It shipped conservative 'applies on restart' on every row and left test_noRowClaimsLiveUntilItsConsumerIsWired to go RED ON PURPOSE once consumers landed. It did. There is also now a test forbidding DEAD apply-states in the mapping -- an unused label is one nobody has verified against a consumer, and the next story will reach for it as if someone had. That is a good pattern to keep.

GATE: 618 tests green, 1 skipped (PRE-EXISTING test_token.py:70 POSIX file-mode on Windows, same skip US-525/528/530/531/532 all documented). Re-run green after all three mutation reverts. ruff clean on all 16 files; validate_config.py passes. No separate ad-hoc smoke, deliberately -- unlike prior F-126 stories these tests boot a REAL StatesHttpServer on a real port and drive a REAL authenticated POST, so a hand-rolled smoke would have been strictly weaker than the suite.

*** FOR PM -- TWO THINGS BEFORE THE SPRINT CLOSES. *** (1) RUN THE FULL SUITE. US-533 is NOT additive the way US-532 was: ApplicationOrchestrator.__init__, createOrchestratorFromConfig and main.runWorkflow each gained a parameter, and the card-state emitter's provider construction changed. All backward-compatible via configPath=None, which is why ~80 orchestrator test files still pass -- but 'the default preserves behaviour' is precisely the claim a full suite exists to check. (2) THREE REDS STILL ON THE BRANCH, none mine, all US-536 fallout, all filed on I-us536 (third appended by me during US-537). They must be retired or the full-suite gate is meaningless.

LIVE VALIDATION OWED FOR THE WHOLE F-126 FEATURE (do not read 6/6 as validated): toggle auto-rotate -> UI reloads -> carousel picks up the new period WITH NO states-http restart; power mode -> wall -> tile follows within one emit cycle; reboot -> both survive via the overlay. Plus US-537's still-owed AllocateRingBuffer drill with auto-rotate ON. Nothing on the dev box can prove the polkit half of B1, and it cuts BOTH ways -- the dev box also cannot prove we no longer need the privilege.

ENVIRONMENT: `make` is NOT on PATH -- `make lint` exits 127, WHICH READS LIKE A PASS; use `python -m ruff check` per touched file (TD-075 keeps project-wide ruff at exit 1 on a clean tree). NEW GOTCHA: the Bash tool is POSIX sh, so PowerShell here-string syntax (@'...'@) in `git commit -m` silently becomes PART OF THE MESSAGE -- it put a stray '@' in my subject and I had to amend. Use a real heredoc with `git commit -F -`. Re-confirmed: unscoped grep/ripgrep over the whole tree gets backgrounded on this SMB share; scope to src/ or one dir.
